scope: Twelve-bit mode/mode_set_masked, setgid inheritance, sticky checks, cross-protocol set-ID clearing and setuid-owner restriction. Full SMB/NFS remains incomplete.

checks: v3 special mode creation and v4 masked updates preserve unmasked bits; high-only masks preserve exact ACL bytes; combined masked mode applies before ACL
undefined mode bits, conflicting mode attributes and masked mode in CREATE/OPEN/GETATTR/VERIFY reject without creation
NFS data writes, truncation and ownership setters clear file set-ID bits
setgid directories transmit primary group and directory setgid to nonmember creators; explicit setgid requires verified group membership
sticky directories reject foreign unlink, rename and replacement while permitting the object owner
encrypted SMB writes clear NFS set-ID bits; SMB disposition and rename cannot bypass NFS sticky directories
staged DAV replacement clears set-ID; removing sticky restores unlink; special modes persist through complete restart
NFSv3 mode is enforced, owner/group are mapped, nonowner chmod denied; NFSv4 advertises real ACL support
group mode checks use only verified AUTH_SYS groups; omitted groups and root-squashed groups cannot grant access
ACL+mode applies mode then ACL; named-user ACE roundtrips, READ_ACL is enforced and chmod masks named grants
invalid ACL principal and flags fail before truncation; empty ACL denies data and owner can recover WRITE_ACL
special/named groups and primary-group changes enforce the mapped trustee; opaque SMB SIDs roundtrip; execute-only NFS READ/OPEN/ACCESS works; invalid CREATE ACL leaves no object
directory ACL inheritance preserves OWNER@ and clears the acl-only inherited flag; ACL attributes larger than 4 KiB roundtrip
NFS chmod and ACL changes govern new SMB opens of the same object
shared ACLs, symbolic principals and derived mode survive complete service restart
schema 5 migration backs up each file authority before adding persistent security descriptors
self-relative owner/group/DACL query, requested sections, required buffer size and READ_CONTROL/WRITE_DAC/SACL boundaries
ordered deny/allow access checks, MAXIMUM_ALLOWED and explicit-right intersection; existing handles retain granted rights
SMB denial enforced by NFSv3 READ/ACCESS, NFSv4 ACCESS, core API and WebDAV readonly aliases
ACE order, empty versus NULL DACL, implicit owner rights and OWNER RIGHTS SID
malformed offsets, overlaps, truncation and unsupported ACEs rejected atomically; ownership cannot be assigned to another user
file/directory inheritance with CREATOR OWNER substitution and multi-generation propagation; ACL follows rename
SecD CREATE persists protected initial ACL, validates ownership and rejects duplicate/malformed contexts before mutation
group ACE enforcement and membership revocation use freshly signed identity grants
schema 6 durability across process restart; replacement object receives fresh owner and ACL
NFS writer publication still enforces file DACL; WRITE and chmod cannot bypass SMB restrictions
DAV writer cannot bypass ACL; staged PUT retains restrictions, recursive COPY checks descendants and inherits destination ACL through private staging parents
DAV LOCK on unmapped URL checks parent create rights and persists inherited DACL

source_notes: Core/ACL/shared-security regressions preceded the final owner-only setuid check. The final independent mode test includes that ownership boundary and passes. Remote jobs run the exact committed source.
